resources.string: Kamakhya AI requires microphone access to stream real-time 16 kHz PCM voice audio to Gemini Live when you explicitly start listening.
Kamakhya AI requires contact read access only when you ask to look up a contact name to pre-fill the phone dialer.

Security Notice: Credentials are encrypted at rest using Android Keystore AES-GCM. However, storing an API key on a client device does not make it completely secret from someone who controls the physical device or inspects the runtime environment. For production deployments, Google recommends ephemeral tokens minted by a backend.
Ask Kamakhya AI or enter a command (English / Hindi / Hinglish)…
